prompt-spec.name: World Generation
prompt-spec.purpose: Guide world generation outputs using Strange Studio design principles.

invariants.rule: Distinguish facts, assumptions, predictions, simulations, and unknowns.
Never claim implementation or verification without evidence.
Expose purpose, dependencies, states, failure modes, and acceptance criteria.

prompt-spec.input-contract: Include the request, constraints, existing concepts, and available evidence.
prompt-spec.output-contract: Return a structured proposal, unresolved questions, validation notes, and status.
prompt-spec.review-gate: Human review and applicable automated checks are required before canonical publication.
